title: South Africa's Second Nationally Determined Contribution under the Paris Agreement
temporal_coverage: Recent climate impacts, current vulnerability reporting, adaptation commitments for 2031-2035, and future climate risks.
limitations: National self-report; disaggregated impact data are limited.

title: 3 Sector Climate Readiness Study: Consolidated Workshop Report
organization: Presidential Climate Commission; prepared by OneWorld Sustainable Investments
temporal_coverage: Sector adaptation-readiness workshops and synthesis, with discussion of current capacity and institutional arrangements.
methodology: PCC workshop synthesis of sector presentations and group discussions.

title: Cape Winelands District Municipality Risk Profile Report
organization: Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), GreenBook
temporal_coverage: Vulnerability indices for 1996 and 2011; climate baselines and modeled drought, flood and water-supply risks through 2050.
methodology: GIS model using secondary indicators, hazard data and settlement projections.
limitations: Not locally surveyed; social indicators are dated; water estimates omit reticulation condition.

title: Weather and Crime—Cautious evidence from South Africa
organization: Jorg Ankel-Peters, Anna Bruederle and Gareth Roberts; Q Open
temporal_coverage: Monthly crime and weather observations from January 2001 to March 2012.
methodology: Peer-reviewed reduced-form study of monthly police crime records and gridded weather across 1,158 wards, using an SPEI drought measure.
limitations: Weather, not anthropogenic climate, is studied; effects are subtle, no mediation analysis is conducted, and monthly data limit mechanism interpretation.
